replies.text: (2/2) These changes can start by closing the "observation status" hospital stay loophole in Medicare, expanding Health Savings Accounts to fit families' lives and reforming plans to include modern services like telehealth.

(2/2) Pharmacies like this have stepped up to help patients during and after the pandemic.
(2/2) This bill honors the rights of individuals with Down syndrome by federally banning doctors from knowingly performing an abortion because a baby received a prenatal diagnosis of Down syndrome.
